main.description: A named project that provenance records can belong to. The key is a slug chosen by the creator (lowercase letters, digits and hyphen, 1 to 64 characters, no hyphen at the start or end, no two hyphens in a row); the backend and the CLI enforce that rule, the lexicon cannot express it. A rename changes the name, never the key.

description.description: What the project is; optional, and absent means empty.
